scope: Two worked sequence-to-mechanism-to-route examples: the existing BUB1B research hypothesis and an explicitly synthetic TRIP13 homozygous genotype from public literature. No second patient was analyzed, and no drug response was measured.

cases.input_type: existing hypothesis reconstructed from public reference sequence
cases.genotype: Two heterozygous coding SNVs; trans hypothesis, phase unresolved
cases.external_check_source: Existing reference reconstruction: ../track2-model/allele-inputs.json; Leu737Ter also ClinVar variation 533901. This is not new variant discovery.

cases.input_type: synthetic homozygous public genotype; no patient phenotype or reads
cases.genotype: c.[1060C>T];[1060C>T] is stipulated for this example

bubr1-insufficiency-hypothesis.summary: BUBR1 insufficiency is supported for selected MVA1 alleles. The actual N1002K abundance/function and phase remain unmeasured.

causal_protein_matches_stabilization_tar.basis: Conditional on the proposed pair, the affected protein is BUBR1; selected human MVA1 mutants show abundance defects (Suijkerbuijk 2010).

proximal_pathway_to_target_bridge.basis: North 2014 supplies an NMN/SIRT2-to-BUBR1 bridge; Pirinen 2020 supplies niacin-to-human-muscle-NAD engagement. Joining these interventions is a hypothesis, not niacin/BUB1B rescue.

nad-bubr1.next: Confirm trans and an abundance-limited, functional N1002K substrate; measure niacin exposure, NAD/SIRT2 engagement, BUBR1 mediation, segregation fidelity and productive muscle output. A full-length sequence is not a functional protein measurement.

actual_mutant_rescued_by_drug_at_relevan.basis: No N1002K/arimoclomol rescue supplied. HSP90 dependence of selected BUBR1 mutants does not establish rescue by this medicine.

arimoclomol.next: Demonstrate actual-mutant function at justified exposure before promoting proteostasis support beyond a reserve hypothesis.

harmful_excess_mtorc1_in_relevant_model.basis: Current proposal has only qualitative carrier-mouse phosphoprotein bands and no confirming muscle RNA result; no affected/corrected human model establishes harmful excess.

normalization_preserves_productive_tissu.basis: No drug or genetic-normalization experiment has measured productive output in the proposed model.

mtorc1.next: Qualify harmful excess and causal partial normalization first; then measure drug engagement, tissue output and renewal. Keep as a probe, not an automatically transferred rescue.

trip13-null.summary: Published Arg354Ter cells lacked detectable TRIP13 and had checkpoint/segregation defects rescued by WT TRIP13; mutant rescue failed. MAD2 remodeling supplies a distinct checkpoint mechanism.

causal_protein_matches_stabilization_tar.basis: The sequence lesion and published genetic rescue concern TRIP13, not BUBR1. A shared checkpoint phenotype does not establish that raising BUBR1 substitutes for TRIP13.

proximal_pathway_to_target_bridge.basis: The bounded source set supplies no NAD/SIRT2-to-TRIP13 rescue or validated BUBR1 bypass.

nad-bubr1.next: Test TRIP13-specific correction and successful chromosome segregation as a positive control; a BUBR1 bypass would require direct evidence. Non-transfer is an evidence decision, not proof that a bypass is impossible.

actual_mutant_rescued_by_drug_at_relevan.basis: Published WT rescue does not show pharmacological rescue of Arg354Ter; its expressed mutant failed checkpoint rescue.

arimoclomol.next: Any truncation-rescue or readthrough mechanism needs its own transcript, protein-function and exposure evidence. It is not the full-length missense-stabilization route transferred from BUB1B.

harmful_excess_mtorc1_in_relevant_model.basis: No TRIP13-genotype-specific harmful mTORC1 excess is established by the selected primary sources.

normalization_preserves_productive_tissu.basis: No relevant output-preserving rescue is supplied.

mtorc1.next: Establish a relevant causal signaling abnormality and functional rescue before nominating this downstream drug. Shared MVA labeling is insufficient.

yost2017.title: Yost et al., Biallelic TRIP13 mutations predispose to Wilms tumor and chromosome missegregation
yost2017.scope: Table 1, Figs. 1–3 and supplements: public Arg354Ter genotype, RNA/protein findings and genetic rescue; no repurposed-drug rescue.

kim2018.title: TRIP13 and APC15 drive mitotic exit by turnover of interphase- and unattached kinetochore-produced MCC
kim2018.scope: TRIP13 loss, MAD2 state, checkpoint activation and silencing; mechanistic context, not this synthetic example's experimental result.

clinvar431045.title: ClinVar VCV000431045.1
clinvar431045.scope: Pathogenic, one literature-only OMIM submission, no assertion criteria (zero stars); exact MANE variant. This is not expert-panel review or independent evidence from Yost.

suijkerbuijk2010.title: Suijkerbuijk et al., Molecular causes for BUBR1 dysfunction in the human cancer predisposition syndrome mosaic variegated aneuploidy
suijkerbuijk2010.scope: Selected human MVA1 mutant abundance defects and expression rescue; N1002K was not tested.

north2014.title: North et al., SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan
north2014.scope: NMN abundance experiments and separate genetic SIRT2 experiments; neither proves niacin/N1002K rescue.

pirinen2020.title: Pirinen et al., Niacin Cures Systemic NAD+ Deficiency and Improves Muscle Performance in Adult-Onset Mitochondrial Myopathy
pirinen2020.scope: Human muscle NAD engagement in another disease; strength also improved in treated healthy controls, so disease-specific functional rescue is unestablished.
